{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.50

|gr1= Strings

|descr= Joins ''array'' into [[String]] with provided ''separator''. Array can be of mixed types, all elements will be converted to [[String]] prior to joining, but the fastest operation is on the array of [[String]]s.

|s1= array [[joinString]] separator

|p1= array: [[Array]] of [[Anything]]

|p2= separator: [[String]] - separator used to join array elements.

|r1= [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>
_str = "- This, is a sample string." splitString "-,. "; // ["This","is","a","sample","string"]
_str joinString " "; // "This is a sample string"
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>["This","is","sparta"] joinString " ~ "; // "This ~ is ~ sparta"</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>["1",2,text "3"] joinString ""; // "123"</sqf>

|x4= <sqf>"Japa is the best!" splitString "" joinString " "; // "J a p a   i s   t h e   b e s t !"</sqf>

|x5= Remove all \r\n from file:
<sqf>loadFile "somefile.txt" splitString toString [13,10] joinString " "</sqf>

|seealso= [[splitString]] [[set]] [[resize]] [[reverse]] [[select]] [[in]] [[find]] [[toArray]] [[forEach]] [[count]] [[deleteAt]] [[deleteRange]] [[append]] [[sort]] [[param]] [[params]] [[arrayIntersect]] [[toString]] [[endl]], {{Link|http://www.utf8-chartable.de/|Unicode Character Table}}
}}
